mapper.select: WITH request_bounds AS ( SELECT ST_Envelope( ST_Buffer( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{radius} )::geometry ) AS geom ), landcover_geometries AS ( SELECT l.osm_type, l.osm_id, l.landcover_type, l.name, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract( ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology( ST_Intersection(l.geom, b.geom), #{tolerance} ), 3 )) AS geom FROM gis.landcover l CROSS JOIN request_bounds b WHERE l.geom && b.geom AND ST_Intersects(l.geom, b.geom) ), landcover_features AS ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', 'landcover/' || osm_type || '/' || osm_id, 'properties', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'landcoverType', landcover_type, 'name', NULLIF(name, '') )), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, 6)::jsonb ) AS feature FROM landcover_geometries WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) ), water_geometries AS ( SELECT w.osm_type, w.osm_id, w.water_type, w.name, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract( ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology( ST_Intersection(w.geom, b.geom), #{tolerance} ), 3 )) AS geom FROM gis.water w CROSS JOIN request_bounds b WHERE w.geom && b.geom AND ST_Intersects(w.geom, b.geom) ), water_features AS ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', 'water/' || osm_type || '/' || osm_id, 'properties', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'waterType', water_type, 'name', NULLIF(name, '') )), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, 6)::jsonb ) AS feature FROM water_geometries WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) ), road_geometries AS ( SELECT r.osm_type, r.osm_id, r.road_type, r.name, r.ref, r.bridge, r.tunnel, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract( ST_Simplify( ST_Intersection(r.geom, b.geom), #{tolerance} ), 2 )) AS geom FROM gis.road r CROSS JOIN request_bounds b WHERE r.geom && b.geom AND ST_Intersects(r.geom, b.geom) ), road_features AS ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', 'road/' || osm_type || '/' || osm_id, 'properties', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'roadType', road_type, 'name', NULLIF(name, ''), 'ref', NULLIF(ref, ''), 'bridge', NULLIF(bridge, ''), 'tunnel', NULLIF(tunnel, '') )), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, 6)::jsonb ) AS feature FROM road_geometries WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) ) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'ThematicMap', 'landcover', jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(feature) FROM landcover_features), '[]'::jsonb) ), 'water', jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(feature) FROM water_features), '[]'::jsonb) ), 'roads', jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(feature) FROM road_features), '[]'::jsonb) ), 'metadata', jsonb_build_object( 'source', 'OpenStreetMap / PostgreSQL / PostGIS', 'attribution', '© OpenStreetMap contributors', 'center', jsonb_build_array(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 'radius', #{radius}, 'simplificationTolerance', #{tolerance}, 'timestamp', to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') ) )::text
